## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Closes #...`.

## Validation

State the relevant test and CI results. Packaging changes need native macOS checks.
Describe any remaining limitations.

- [ ] Linked issue and dedicated branch
- [ ] English and French user documentation updated where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, private configuration or unredacted personal logs
- [ ] New packaging revision if installer bytes change; existing releases preserved
